title: Tips & Tricks
description: Advanced tips and tricks for getting the most out of your HP OMEN laptop, including AMD Ryzen tuning, GPU power management, and audio optimization.

If your discrete GPU is running at idle when it shouldn't (draining battery), use this community-made tool to restart it and force it back to sleep.
To automatically reset the dGPU when waking from sleep/hibernate:

items: Press Win + R, type taskschd.msc and press Enter
Click 'Create Task...' in the right panel
Check 'Run with highest privileges' and set 'Configure for Windows 10'
Go to Triggers tab → New → Select 'On an Event'
Select Custom → New Event Filter → By Source → Check 'Power-Troubleshooter'
Where it says 'All Event IDs', type 1 and click OK
Go to Actions tab → New → Browse and select GPUReset.exe
In Conditions tab, uncheck everything
In Settings tab, set 'Stop task if runs longer than' to 1 hour
Click OK - test by putting laptop to sleep and waking it

blocks.content: Optimize the Bang & Olufsen audio on your OMEN using the OMEN Audio Control settings:

items: Open OMEN Gaming Hub and navigate to Audio Control
Enable 'Voice' mode for podcasts/videos, 'Music' for general listening
Use 'Gaming' mode during gameplay for enhanced directional audio
Adjust equalizer bands to your preference - try boosting 100Hz for bass
Enable 'Smart Volume' to prevent sudden loud sounds

blocks.title: Trade-off
blocks.content: Disabling turbo boost reduces performance by 10-20% but lowers temperatures by 10-20°C (50-68°F). This is a reversible process with no risk.
To access the hidden turbo boost setting in Windows:

blocks.filename: Enable Turbo Boost Option in Power Settings
blocks.code:
# Run in PowerShell as Administrator
# This adds the 'Processor performance boost mode' option to Power Options

powercfg -attributes SUB_PROCESSOR PERFBOOSTMODE -ATTRIB_HIDE

items: Run the command above in an elevated PowerShell
Right-click battery icon → Power Options → Change plan settings
Click 'Change advanced power settings'
Navigate to: Processor power management → Processor performance boost mode
Set to 'Disabled' to turn off turbo boost (limits to base clock)
Set to 'Aggressive' to re-enable turbo boost

blocks.content: A cooling pad is a cheap investment that can lower temperatures by 3-7°C, improving performance and longevity.

blocks.title: Budget Option
blocks.content: You don't necessarily need an expensive cooling pad! Simply elevating the rear of your laptop (with a book, wallet, or even a 2x4 piece of wood) can drop temps by 3-5°C by improving airflow to the bottom vents.

items: Elevation only: 3-5°C reduction - use any angled stand or prop
Elevation + fans: 5-7°C reduction - get a pad with adjustable angle and fans
Look for cooling pads with mesh surface for maximum airflow
Get creative - 3D print a custom stand or use household items!

For most users, Windows Defender (built into Windows) is better than even paid antivirus programs. Third-party antivirus software can be resource-intensive and some are borderline malware themselves.

blocks.title: Warning About Antivirus Software
blocks.content: Some popular antivirus programs have been caught: mining cryptocurrency on users' devices (causing high temps and poor performance), selling user data, and providing minimal additional protection over Windows Defender.

items: Keep Windows Defender enabled and updated
Don't download software from untrusted sources
If you need to visit risky sites, use a Virtual Machine (VM) instead
Uninstall any pre-installed third-party antivirus (like McAfee) for better performance
